segments.text: One of Kazushi's friends who was transferred to Eiden Academy. Nicknamed Appo because of the similarity of his look to an apple. Also hopes to find a girlfriend in his new school.
2年生。主人公の悪友。風体が「毒リンゴ」な事からアッポーのニックネームがつく。
一志の悪友。アッポーだけが彼女持ち。
主人公の悪友。
その風体が「なんか毒リンゴみてぇじゃね？」との事から「アッポー」と呼ばれる。
「イケイケどんどん」を行動ベースに日々、女にモテる事を考えている軍団の自称ボス的な存在。しかし頭部の出っ張りを握ると弱気になる弱点（？）を持つ。
独自の様々なルートを持っており、知識だけは豊富だが偏った傾向がある。
基本的にはお調子者でイイ奴なのだが、こと「女」に関しては他の奴を出し抜こうと日々画策している。いち早く「童貞」を捨てる事が彼のたったひとつの夢なのだから……。
She is best friends with Kazuko Fuusen. She doesn't approve of boys and together with Kazuko is hostile towards them. They will all get along at some point.

その握力は林檎を軽く潰し、その包容力は熊をも倒す。
そして、その屈強な体型からは想像できない乙女な部分を持っている。
メロンを林檎のように食べたりとか。

「微妙に化粧している所がなんか殺意を覚える」などと可哀想な事を言われている。

One of Kazushi's friends who was transferred to Eiden Academy. Among the group, he is known to be the most sensitive aswell as kind. Just like Kazushi and the others, he is hoping to find a girlfriend at his new school.

常にジャージを愛用しており、その巨漢から体育会系を彷彿とさせるがただジャージが好きなだけで特にスポーツはやっていない。というか隠れオタ。主人公を含めた仲間内では一番の人徳者、かつ常識を弁えている。

巨体からは想像がつかないがわりと細かい作業が好きで米に自作の詩を書いたりする。

As the granddaughter of the school director, Haruka was born and raised in the pristine natural environment of Eiden island. With a warm-hearted and energetic disposition, her natural innocence has long since captivated the hearts of those around her.

Being not very well versed in the outside world, she often appears to be clumsy or obtuse, leading to her claims that "my good point is my health!" despite consistently testing into the top of her class; especially on the subjects of math and science. Recently she has taken an interest in the newly transferred boys.
From MangaGamer
詠伝学園2年生。
豊かな自然に囲まれた詠伝島で生まれ育った生粋の島育ち。
おおらかな性格で、いつも元気いっぱいな裏表のない女の子。
「元気だけがとりえ！」と言いつつも実は頭もよく、常に成績はトップクラス。
特に理数系、科学系の分野を得意とする。
しかし島の外の情報には非常に疎く、そのせいかちょっと天然に見える一面も。
島の外から来た男子に対して物凄い興味深々な態度を取ってくる。
そのうえ、わりと無防備なので、周囲を同性異性問わずドキドキさせている。
ちなみに、学園長のお孫さんでもある。
前作のヒロイン。
学園長の孫で、一応お嬢様。
いつも明るく、ちょっと天然。
一志とはクラスが違うので微妙に仲間はずれにされ気味。

Mizuki loves to swim; in fact, the reason why she enrolled at Eiden is so that she could swim in the ocean whenever she wanted. With the soft currents and warm waters, she used to swim naked from time to time, but hasn't ever since the boys saw her.

She is very athletic and a little boyish, making her so popular amongst the girls that she has a bodyguard squad, but she has no interest in them. Due to her lack of experience around boys, she sometimes comes off as a little hostile towards them, but she actually yearns to be in love. Also, she loves fancy accessories, just like any other girl.
From MangaGamer
詠伝学園2年生。
泳ぐことが大好きで、「海に囲まれていつでも泳いでいたい」とこの学園に入学してきたスポーツ少女。
詠伝島の周りの海は潮の関係で常に暖かく、まさにうってつけなのだ。
水着がなくても時間さえあれば裸で泳いでたりする（男子が来て目撃されてからは自粛しているようだが）。
そのボーイッシュさに女子のファンも多く、学園の中には親衛隊がいる程。でも本人は同性には興味はない。
男子に対して極端に免疫が無いため粗暴になりがちだが、
恋愛に対する憧れは人並みに持っているし、ファンシーな小物に目を輝かせたりする普通の女の子。
前作のヒロイン。
泳ぐのが何より好きな水泳少女。
わりと常識的な性格なので突っ込みに回ることが多く、気苦労が絶えない。

Her hobby is to make money; she believes that "even dirty money builds houses" and swindles the boys out of their money by pawning off things like "how to be popular among girls" (false, of course) and "a picture of a naked woman" (supposedly). The only subject she's good at is counting money. Despite her less than timid activities, she's actually quite shy and is uncomfortable being in a group.

Mei is the protagonist's teacher. She is a graduate of Eiden Academy and in her mid-20's. She attracts boys, including the protagonist, with her mature charm, which is sometimes used to control them. Although unusual at an all girls school, she is very popular among the female students. The girls respect and look up to her, often coming to her for advice. When she drinks, her personality changes and she starts bawling.
From MangaGamer

Panchuu is also one of the transfered boys but he is 1 year older than Kazushi and his friends so he is their senpai. His speech is very difficult to understand. Kazushi and his friends look up to him as a big brother figure. He likes bread and his family owns a bakery called "Iida Bakery".

Aozora Hisae while she was still young. She appears only in Kazushi's dreams as a flashback during Haruka's route and her story is used to explain the tragedy and the following psychogical trauma that used to shape her as a person later on.
A lonely shopkeeper that used to be a master alchemist in the past. He came on Hisae's call to Eiden island hoping to find the legendary Philosopher's Stone.
He is also a long-lost father that Natsume has been looking for.
Hisae's husband and Haruka's grandfather was a great alchemist that tried to find the Philosopher's Stone. He appears as a ghost during Haruka's route and wants Kazushi to do something for him.

She is Haruka's grandmother and one of the two original founders of Eiden Academy. After passing of her husband, she continued his legacy in search of the legendary Philosopher's Stone. Nowadays she is the principal of Eiden Academy.
A teacher from Kazushi's previous school, who transfered to Eiden Academy too. Strict, likes to use physical punishments but honorable.
